name: RepoPact Core
summary: A repository-native record of intent, authority, work state, decisions, and evidence. The CLI and canonical semantic engine make that state inspectable across people, tools, and sessions.
maturity: Stable CLI package 3.1.3 is published on PyPI. The source tree continues to evolve separately from the packaged release.

name: RepoPact Workbench
summary: A native interface for inspecting repository records, validation, dependencies, evidence, and supported changes prepared through RepoPact Core.
maturity: Available as a source-build preview; no packaged installers are listed. Recorded Windows and Android evidence has explicit platform limits.

name: ForgeWire
summary: ForgeWire is an application and runtime direction for organizing model-assisted work around project context, tools, and selected workflows, with a person reviewing the outcome.
maturity: The public overview describes work in progress, not application source or a supported installation path. ForgeWire remains private development; no public release date is announced.

name: Fabric
summary: Fabric is a separate execution control-plane direction for authenticated, policy-gated work across machines. The public overview describes a limited, configuration-dependent connection for selected ForgeWire workflows.
maturity: Fabric is not a public service or deployment option. Broader integration and release gates remain open; no public download or release date is announced.

name: Anvil
summary: A planning ledger for projects, issues, boards, workflows, and typed links to external work records.
maturity: The JSON store is single-writer, and the API and on-disk schema may change. Anvil links execution records; its documented scope excludes execution ownership and audit trails.

name: Flink
summary: A local-first communication and coordination platform. People own their communication state and decisions; agents enter through governed local interfaces.
maturity: Now maintained in the ForgeWire Labs organization as Flink. The repository version is 2.0.3; the latest published installer is v2.0.1, and its README and release materials retain the former ForgeLink name. Release notes define the installer’s exact feature set.

name: SkillForge Academy
summary: An offline-first desktop application for certification study, practical exercises, and exam preparation.
maturity: The public Windows release is v1.3.2. The current unreleased candidate and newer course-platform surfaces remain in development or beta with separate maturity status.
